newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 4.7 pct Nizhnevartovskneftegaz.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 4.7 pct Nizhnevartovskneftegaz.

text.p: Russia's State Property Committee will auction 861,786 preferred shares in AOOT Nizhnevartovskneftegaz on December 2, the Federal Securities Corporation, said on Thursday.
The shares amount to 4.7 percent of Nizhnevartovskneftegaz's capital, and will be sold in a cash auction.
The starting price for each share with a face value of 1,000 roubles will be 20,000 roubles, it said in a statement.
Nizhnevartovskneftegaz is the main operating company of Tyumenskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (Tyumen Oil), one of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years.
Tyumen Oil, chaired by former energy minister Yury Shafranik, owns 38 percent of Nizhnevartovskneftegaz.
Nizhnevartovskneftegaz preferred shares are not yet traded on the Russian Trading System.
